title: Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604)", at revision 1382095049, opens: "The Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604) was an intermittent conflict between Habsburg Spain and the Kingdom of England that was never formally declared. It began with England's military expedition in 1585 to what was then the Spanish Netherlands under the command of Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester, in support of the Dutch rebellion against Spanish Habsburg rule." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q430726, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1585–1604 war between the kingdoms of Spain and England". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
